recognize_zh: 周邊血中兩個嗜中性球核分葉減少（雙葉或近雙葉），左側細胞還有兩個小型核突起，呈假性 Pelger-Huët 樣異常；但本圖未見芽細胞，無法單獨診斷 AML。
features: Two neutrophils with hypolobated (bilobed) nuclei and coarsely clumped chromatin
Left neutrophil with two small nuclear appendages (drumstick/knob-like projections)
Cytoplasm with fine granules, not clearly hypogranular
Red cells with crenation (echinocytes, likely artifact) and platelets present
No blasts visible in this field
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows two neutrophils with hypolobated, bilobed nuclei and coarsely condensed chromatin, one bearing small nuclear appendages, consistent with pseudo-Pelger-Huët-like change. Cytoplasmic granulation appears preserved. Red cells show crenation, likely a drying artifact, and platelets are present. No circulating blasts are identified in this field; the image demonstrates neutrophil nuclear abnormalities only and is not by itself diagnostic of AML with mutated CEBPA.

ddx.vs: The inherited anomaly affects nearly all neutrophils uniformly with normal granulation and no cytopenias, whereas acquired pseudo-Pelger change is patchy and accompanies a myeloid neoplasm.
Agents such as mycophenolate, taxanes, or valproate can produce identical hypolobation; drug history and resolution after withdrawal distinguish.
Bands have a continuous curved nucleus without the discrete bilobed spectacle-like configuration and coarse chromatin clumping.
